description: Wifi-användning is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gävle kommun. This data set has been deprecated and is not recommended for any use. Data from public access points owned by the municipality of Gävle. Information is gathered from an API and the responses are saved as JSON files, one JSON file per API call. Coverage: Gävle kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Wifi usage data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Gävle kommun. Its keywords include wifi, internet, usage data, accesspunkter, användningsdata, access points. The listing shows 2021-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
